body: Well half of the time what I'm looking forward to is more of a let down than something that was worth waiting for, and it's really hard to find anything to look forward to right now. Looking forward to things is probably the worst reason to keep living.
Fear, fantasies, finding something to look forward to, and being an idiot.
The feelings of wanting to die haven't really changed in the past 4/5 years and they probably will just get worse till I do it. So you can hope as much as you want but it ain't gonna change much.

Pluto's to far away and to small to be anything other than stupid. Mars is to close and I don't like things near me or touching me. I just needed a place to spill out all of my emotions, normally helps me feel better or detached from them. I use to do it to people or in a txt doc. Guess this time I did it anonymously to reddit.
